subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box: 1 10 =
stimulus: waste know follow observe do make fall are utilize is   We should (a) the life style of the ants and bees. They (b) good use of their time and store food for the rainy days. They never (c)  a single moment in negligence or indolence. So they never (d)  into extreme    crisis. We (e) the best creatures in creation. We (f) everything good and bad. We can (g) better than   the others. We should all (h) every moment properly. Punctuality (i) the best tonic in this regard. We  should (j) the footsteps of the famous persons.
guide_solution: (a) observe; (b) make; (c) waste; (d) fall; (e) are; (f) know; (g) do; (h) utilize; (i) is; (j) follow.
